about: Code that is no longer used but not removed yet. Nothing here moves: an entry only notes it. tools/check_quarantine.py fails once an entry is 14 days old and `usage` (a regular expression for calls, not the definition) still finds nothing; then the code is removed together with its entry. If `usage` finds calls again, the entry is dropped.

entries.name: Unused list of node reference fields in the run context
entries.why: Defined next to SYNTAX_HINT, which spells the fields itself; nothing reads _FIELDS. Found in the dead-code review of 2026-11-23.

entries.name: The "Can watch" chips of the guard editor (hidden on purpose, may come back)
entries.why: The owner hid the "Can watch" chips on 2026-11-24 (every guard may watch every scope for now) but may want them back in a day or two; the data (scope_types), the API and the checks stay. He decides in one or two weeks whether to drop the control for good.
